put.description: Rebinding the request type is refused while a revision is published: it would move future requests of both types onto this chain without an explicit decision.

put.summary: Create or replace the definition's single draft revision
put.description: The whole graph is replaced: what the caller last sent is exactly what would be published. A definition holds at most one draft, so the document under review cannot be confused with another.

get.description: A user outside the caller's data scope is reported as not found, not forbidden, so the caller cannot map which records exist.

put.description: The code cannot be changed. System roles may be edited but not deactivated.
A caller cannot grant a permission they do not hold themselves, which is what stops role management from becoming a privilege-escalation path.

get.description: A request outside the caller's scope is reported as not found rather than forbidden.

put.description: Only the requester may change a request, and only while it is a draft or was returned for correction. Supports Idempotency-Key.
The expense type of an existing category cannot change; see the service contract.

get.description: Each definition reports its published revision, if any, and its version history.

post.description: Binding a definition to a request type is what gives OPEX and CAPEX their own chains.

post.summary: Roll back: start a new draft from any prior revision
post.description: Creates (or replaces) the definition's editable draft with a copy of the source revision — published or retired — so that publishing it restores the prior behaviour. The source revision is never mutated; in-flight requests keep their pinned version.

post.summary: Start a new draft from the currently published revision
post.description: The usual path for a change: copy the live chain, edit it, publish it. The live revision is untouched throughout.
A deactivated definition routes nothing, and publishing a revision on it is refused.

post.summary: Retire a published revision without a replacement
post.description: Stops new submissions of that request type. In-flight requests are unaffected because each pins the revision it started under.

post.summary: Publish a draft revision, retiring the one it replaces
post.description: Refused when validation reports any error. In-flight requests keep the version they started under; only new submissions use this one.

get.summary: Search users, paged and restricted to the caller's data scope
get.description: Returns only users the caller may see. The scope predicate is applied in the query, so the paging metadata describes the same set as the rows.

post.description: No password is accepted. A credential setup grant is issued and the user chooses their own password. Cannot grant a role holding permissions the caller lacks.

post.summary: Clear a lockout on a user account
post.description: Resets failedLoginCount and lockedUntil so the user may authenticate again. Has no effect on an account that is not locked.
Narrows where the user's role permissions apply. Only an installation-scoped caller may grant installation-wide scope.

get.summary: Roles assigned to a user, including expired assignments for history

post.description: An optional expiry makes temporary elevation self-terminating. Refused if the role holds permissions the caller does not have.

post.summary: Issue a password reset for a user
post.description: The administrator never sees or sets the password; a reset grant is issued and the link is delivered to the user.
A user cannot deactivate their own account, which would otherwise be a way to permanently lock out the only administrator.

post.summary: Promote a theme to the installation default
Create or update a single setting

get.summary: List roles with their permissions and active holder counts

post.description: The code must be unique and is immutable afterwards, because workflow configuration and audit records refer to roles by code.

Exports the register using the same filters, scope and inclusive date semantics as the register endpoint. Formats: CSV (RFC 4180 with UTF-8 BOM and formula-injection prefixes), EXCEL (.xlsx via streaming SXSSF). Returns 400 if the matching set exceeds 200000 rows.

get.summary: List recommending authorities, optionally for one department

post.description: The person must belong to the department. One active authority per department and classification over any period.

get.summary: List active organization units as a flat list

post.description: Bootstraps the singleton profile. Fails if a profile already exists.

patch.description: Partial update: only the supplied fields are applied.

post.description: The backing organization unit is created in the same transaction.

post.summary: Mark all notifications as read for the current user
Activate or deactivate a tax authority
Record an effective period for a currency pair
post.description: Overlapping periods are refused, so exactly one rate can apply at any instant.
Sets effectiveTo (defaulting to now) so the rate stops applying. The rate value is not edited; conversions that happened under it still resolve to this row.

get.description: Inactive currencies are included only on request.

post.summary: Test an integration connection (no side effects on provider)
Deactivate an integration (prevents new executions, retains history)
Create or update a feature flag
Enable or disable a feature flag

get.summary: List requests visible to the caller
get.description: Scoped to the caller's data scopes. Set mineOnly=true for the 'My Request' register.

post.summary: Create a request as a draft
post.description: The request number is allocated from the installation's sequence. A draft is checked for internal consistency only; completeness is enforced at submission. Supports Idempotency-Key.
Applies every conditional rule for the request's classification. Submission does not choose approvers: routing belongs to the workflow engine. Supports Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Withdraw a request before a decision
post.description: Only the requester may cancel. An approved request cannot be cancelled; reversing it is a separate operation. Supports Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Add a subcategory to a category

post.description: One active rule per nature, classification and currency; overlapping thresholds are refused because the outcome would otherwise depend on row order.

post.summary: Upload a document and attach it to an expense request

get.summary: List delegation rules, optionally for one category

post.summary: Create a delegation rule with its approval chain
post.description: Overlapping active rules for the same classification and amount are refused by a database exclusion constraint.
The rule stops applying from now and remains readable for historical routes.

post.summary: Preview the approval chain for a hypothetical request
post.description: Uses the same resolver as request submission, so the preview cannot disagree with what submission would do.

Preview a rendered version of the template with sample placeholder values

get.summary: List committees with their levels and members

post.description: The committee code is immutable: published workflows and delegation rules refer to it.
At most one active CEO, CFO and head of administration is permitted per committee.
Refused while the member is seated on an active level, because that would silently disable an approval path.

post.summary: Add an amount band with its seats
post.description: A band whose quorum exceeds its seats is refused: it could never approve anything.

post.summary: Deactivate a committee and its levels

post.description: Establishes a server-side session and sets the JSESSIONID cookie. Returns the caller's profile, roles and effective permissions.
Always returns the same message, whether or not the address is registered.
Requires the current password. Returns 200 with no body on success.
Requires the one-time installation token in the X-Installation-Token header. Permanently closes once completed.
Returns the request for correction. Remarks are required (BRD 8.5). The destination is the revision's declared revert target, or its initial state. Supports Idempotency-Key.
Ends the request unless the workflow's published revision declares another target. Remarks are required (BRD 8.5). Supports Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Forward an assigned task to another user
post.description: Closes the caller's task and opens an equivalent one for the recipient in the same step, so the delegate's approval counts toward the same quorum. A recipient and remarks are both required (BRD 8.5). Supports Idempotency-Key.
Advances the workflow when the step's quorum is met. Remarks are required (BRD 8.5). Supports Idempotency-Key.

parameters.description: Window start (inclusive, ISO-8601 instant). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

parameters.description: Window end (exclusive, ISO-8601 instant). Defaults to now.
